title: Japanese Communication 2
subtitle: Japanese Communication 2
courseType:
English Language Program

educationalGoal: Japanese Communication 2 is designed to reinforce basic grammar through communication tasks. Students will focus on developing basic skills of communication in modern Japanese reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
advice: Students will be able to handle a wider variety of conversational situations and read and write simple letters and essays. They will also become familiar with various aspects of Japanese culture, including sociolinguistic elements essential for accurate communication. Five chapters (Lessons 11-15) will be covered, and 78 new kanji will be introduced. This course has a Moodle course site. All important information about course related matters will be posted on this site. It is students' responsibility to check the site regularly.

achievementLevels.ideal: - For each topic, understand the meaning of important words and phrases and be able to use them appropriately in context. - Understand fundamental grammatical structures and apply that knowledge appropriately in context. - Appropriately exhibit conversational skills for speech acts such as introductions and describing things. - Pick up important information from authentic materials. - Develop effective study skills.
achievementLevels.standard: - For each topic, understand the meaning of important words and phrases. - Understand fundamental grammatical structures. - Understand conversational skills necessary for speech acts such as introductions and describing things. - Pick up some important information from authentic materials. - Understand effective study skills.
